svg.aria-label: dsh-ifc-qto structure: one local .ifc text is read by ifc.unit_check for the unit declaration and by ifc.ingest into 14 element classes and 3 quantity kinds stored as model_id in the ifc domain models table; ifc.qto_summary computes count, total and min/max plus the non-positive issue, and ifc.export_csv writes exports/ifc_92f1f2cfc519059a.csv with 11 rows and a sha256
svg.title: dsh-ifc-qto: one take-off sheet, four local tools

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif

svg.text: one local .ifc text → take-off sheet → summary + CSV · text-level, no geometry take-off
